svg.text: An exploded view of the Duronic GHS37. The controller sits in the lamp head, above the LEDs.
Water tank with seven pods; the plants grow
Sits in the water, plugged into socket DC2.
DC1 adapter in, DC2 pump, DC3 rod plug. Its Q2
switches the pump on command C.
The only power input: 24 V DC, 25 W.
Three wires only: +24 V, GND and the pump
Faces down: W = white + red LEDs, B = blue
LEDs. No resistors, fed by the lamp board.
The original: touch keys, its own MCU, J3 from
the rod, Q4/Q5 for W and B.
24 V from J3 down to 5.0 V for the NodeMCU.
Wi-Fi, the app, the light cycle, settings and
Top of the head with the lamp's touch keys,
Green cards: added by SmartGarden. Everything else is the original lamp.
